meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文稿或设计图做成动态视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把网页设计或文字内容做成生动视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn your design or text into motion video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn web designs or text into engaging videos

howto.what: 装上这个技能后,Claude 会把你的视频类请求当作入口:先弄清是新项目还是已有项目,恢复项目状态、记录你的想法,再挑一个对应的工作流来执行。默认会用 HyperFrames(HTML 渲染视频的框架)来出片,除非你指定别的。
howto.when: 当你提出制作、创建、编辑、动画或渲染视频、动画、动态图形的请求(比如宣传片、解释视频、幻灯片等),或者要求检查、预览、发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目时,Claude 会先读这个技能来接管处理。

say.text: 帮我把这个网站做成一段宣传视频。
say.note: 会先询问视频主题,再选择对应流程。

say.text: 给这段采访素材加上中文字幕。
把现有 HyperFrames 项目渲染成视频。
say.note: 会加载命令行工具并执行渲染。

howto.what_en: Claude treats any video request as an entry point: it resumes project state, captures intent, selects a matching workflow, and defaults to HyperFrames output unless another is specified.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests to make, create, edit, animate, or render video/animation/motion graphics, or to inspect, preview, publish existing HyperFrames projects.

say_en.text: Turn this website into a promo video.
say_en.note: Claude asks about the topic, then routes it.

say_en.text: Add Chinese captions to this interview footage.
say_en.note: It adds captions without altering the original footage.

say_en.text: Render my existing HyperFrames project to video.
say_en.note: Loads the CLI and runs the render.
